value.rationale: Exact positivity and conservation of continuous approximations are central to stiff transfer model integrators. The theorem shows precisely when a polynomial of a given degree can match both exact physical endpoint slopes without any overshoot, supplies explicit admissible constructions, and distinguishes robust monotonicity from stricter complete monotonicity at sharp asymptotic polynomial degree cost sqrt(z) versus z. It is a structural benchmark, not merely a local sign check, a trivial renaming, or a claim about a production solver.
